title: Google Gemini always tells me meshy Ai is the best Ai for creating a texture for a low poly model, what is your experience?
author: Odd_Judgment_3513
selftext:
I have a ultra low poly 3d model from my dog and some reference images real pictures of him, is it possible to create one texture with realism and one texture in Minecraft style etc.?

How can I keep the mesh it turns it always into triangles even when I say keep uv map etc. :(

comments.author: Apoptosis-Games
comments.body:
So far, my results have been mixed.

For generating a model based off of photos, Meshy is quite good but it's low-poly model is still very much in beta, and it still struggles with too many polys/vertices, and it textures based on those vertices.

If you already have a low-poly model and are just trying to pin a texture on it, it's quite good at it, and the neat thing is Meshy will give you up to 4 free retries if it messes up or you don't like how it turned out

replies.author: Odd_Judgment_3513
replies.body: Thnx, do you know why it turns the mesh always into triangles, even if i use keep uv map?

replies.author: Apoptosis-Games
replies.body:
Honestly have no idea, I think it just defaults to it.

You can remesh it in quads, but for some reason it won't generate in quads

comments.author: One-Area-2896
comments.body: So far only TripoAI worked for me. The textures are also fairly good. It seems ahead compared to the rest.

replies.author: Odd_Judgment_3513
replies.body: Just tried it, the website is buggy but the ai model is great

replies.author: One-Area-2896
replies.body: Yeah sometimes I can't even log in, but in terms of output, it's the only decent right now.

comments.author: Alayzzzz
comments.body: I think the recent models like nano banana2, seedream5.0 lite and qwen image 2.0 can do the work. Try budgetpixel ai, it has most of the popular models on market.

replies.author: Odd_Judgment_3513
replies.body: But they can only generate images but are not able to texture my 3d model

replies.author: Alayzzzz
replies.body: Gotcha, maybe you can ask for a 3D model. They do focus on image, video and audio generations now.

replies.author: Belmeez
replies.body: He’s specifically asking about 3d models. None of the chat foundational models do this. I.e ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude etc
